China pulled off an INCREDIBLE comeback against Japan at the FIBA Asia Cup 2021 Qualifiers!
Japan had an 80-73 lead in the fourth quarter and looked to be in control, but China turned the game around when it mattered most! Behind Zhou Qi's dominant presence inside and a HUGE 17-4 run to close out the game, China erased the deficit and snatched a 90-84 victory.
Japan had the lead, but China delivered when it mattered most!
Watch the BEST moments from this dramatic finish at the FIBA Asia Cup 2021 Qualifiers!
